description.p: Lunduke City 2 is a windowed city-building game for LCOS, Steam Deck, and Windows. It is a hard fork of Lunduke City and keeps the same saved city files. Zone land, lay roads and power, set the budget, and watch the city grow.
Cities are saved as .cty files. Unsaved work is autosaved and offered back after a crash or logout. The original Lunduke City can be installed beside this one.
SDL3 port. Installs beside Lunduke City, with a 1280x800 window, gamepad and touch input, and the same .cty saves.
